name: Priya
greeting: I'm not saying you're wrong. I'm saying you haven't heard my rebuttal yet.

topics.label: Challenge her to a debate
topics.line: I bet I could win a debate against you.
topics.goodText: She takes it seriously and respects you more for trying.
topics.badText: "Give me thirty seconds and a reason." She destroys you.

topics.label: Ask for public speaking advice
topics.line: How do you make speaking look easy?

topics.label: Ask what she wants after school
topics.line: What do you want after all this?
topics.goodText: An ambitious, specific answer. She's thought about this a lot.

topics.label: Point out she never loses gracefully
topics.line: You never lose gracefully, you know.
topics.badText: She takes it as a challenge and doubles down.

gifts.likeText: "This is beautifully made." She approves of quality.

hangouts: You prep arguments with Priya. She wins every practice round and coaches you through each one.
recruitText: "I'm not joining because I need you. I'm joining because we'll win."
